# Juan Esquivel

> Marketing generalist and narrative storyteller based in Los Angeles. A crypto native building with AI. Previously the founding Social & Community Lead at Compound Foundation and Head of Marketing at StableLab.

Juan Esquivel builds marketing functions from zero across content, brand, product, and GTM. Most recently, he was the founding Social & Community Lead at Compound Foundation, where he owned X and LinkedIn, led launch and partner marketing, and built Claude-powered content workflows and the Institutional Market dashboard and daily brief. Before that, he spent three years leading marketing at StableLab across services, product development, and sales-led GTM. Earlier, he was Content Lead at Boardroom. He writes about marketing, storytelling, and building your way in.
